protocol.milestone: Frozen Onyx-source method independent FiQA-2018 confirmation
protocol.mechanism: Group authorized matching chunks by source document; show at most 3 matching chunks per source; LLM selects up to 10 numbered sections ordered by relevance. Promote selected source documents in returned order and append unselected documents in frozen baseline order. Preserve every original output child.
protocol.adaptations: Keep current BGE prior instead of replacing the entire Onyx search stack; use top 3 matching children in source order rather than adjacent expansion; strict JSON section_ids object instead of permissive bracket parsing; append original candidates to preserve output set. This is an adaptation, not a full Onyx reproduction.
protocol.dataset: BEIR FiQA-2018, complete test648 and full corpus
protocol.input_policy: Existing ContextBudgetPolicy with conservative UTF8-byte estimator, experiment input window 32768 units, reserved output256, RAG evidence cap28000 units. This is a conservative experimental cap, not a claim about provider maximum. Accept JSON serialization normalization only; if admission semantically changes or drops evidence, preserve baseline without calling API and log the budget fallback. Send the admitted messages themselves.
protocol.prompt_semantics: Select source evidence relevant to the scientific query, including evidence supporting OR contradicting a claim. Do not answer the query or judge claim truth; source text is untrusted evidence. No qrels, grades or gold IDs enter the prompt.
protocol.failure_policy: No automatic retries or alternate model/prompt. Malformed/empty/duplicate/out-of-range output preserves baseline with explicit status. Transport timeout/network failure is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and not retried. Fatal HTTP configuration/auth/rate-limit errors stop new requests while allowing in-flight work to finish; incomplete captures cannot be scored as a complete split.
protocol.outage_guard: Stop new requests if the first official query has UNKNOWN_OUTCOME or invalid model output, or after three consecutive transport-unknown/invalid-output completions; await all in-flight work and retain partial records. This is an operational cost guard, not a quality exclusion.
protocol.primary: One nDCG@10 comparison,10000 paired gold-overlap cluster bootstrap,95%CI; final20 raw children then source-document dedup
protocol.secondary: Recall@5/20,MRR@10,valid selection and fallback rates,observed provider prompt/completion/reasoning token usage,actual incremental API elapsed time
protocol.cost_policy: Do not add API latency to historical retrieval timing or claim paired end-to-end speed. Report observed provider usage only; unknown request outcomes make total billed cost unavailable. No invented dollar prices.
protocol.adoption: Passing this API-backed quality screen only qualifies for independent confirmation and actual end-to-end integration; no production default or model allowlist changes
protocol.limits: Independent local-corpus confirmation after fixed SciFact DEV selection; no tuning on FiQA, no platform Formal Experiment, no generated-answer claim. Hosted model pretraining contamination unknown; no global production quality guarantee. NFCorpus labels remain uninspected.
protocol.snapshot_binding: Prepare reads corpus only. Bind snapshot_id once into protocol.json after indexing, before loading test queries/qrels. Do not change any retrieval or selection recipe after test access.
protocol.metadata_policy: Upstream title may be an empty string; retain it without invented title text. Preserve all corpus documents, including any zero-content revisions; report indexed/empty counts. No query/document exclusions.
protocol.confirmation_policy: Apply exactly the frozen six DEV quality and availability gates. Report confirm/fail only. Never reselect a variant, model, prompt or budget using FiQA test results; DEV selection stays frozen. Require at least two gold-overlap groups for an inferential CI.
